The Elements @ Ampang is a freehold serviced residence in Ampang Hilir, Kuala Lumpur, developed by Elite Forward Sdn Bhd, a joint venture between Land & General Berhad and Mayland Group. The project was completed in 2013 to 2014 and is positioned in the Ampang Embassy Row corridor, approximately 3 to 4 km from KLCC.

The Elements @ Ampang is located off Jalan Ampang, in Ampang Hilir, within the Embassy Row corridor of Kuala Lumpur. The development is surrounded by embassies, international schools, and expatriate-oriented amenities, close to Great Eastern Mall and Gleneagles Hospital.

The Elements @ Ampang is accessible via the Ampang-Kuala Lumpur Elevated Highway (AKLEH), Jalan Ampang, Jalan Tun Razak, Duta-Ulu Kelang Expressway (DUKE), MRR2, and SMART Tunnel. These roads and highways connect the Ampang Hilir corridor toward KLCC, the city centre, and surrounding areas.
